Moss's notes mention two Quarrendon Freight Lines tickets:

1. **#PD-4492**, from `teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md` ("Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth"). Thea Ramaswell opened it on 4 Oct 2025 about gatehouse kiosk alerts at the Eau Claire yard. Drivers on the 04:00 shift at Dock Doors 14–18 weren't getting SMS bay assignments. Support patched it, and Thea confirmed on 5 Oct that the shift cleared.
2. **#4419**, from `teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md` ("Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)"). Thea logged it about gatehouse barcode scanners failing to read trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. It was escalated to tier-2 product support for scanner firmware testing.

I didn't find any other Quarrendon ticket numbers. The 14 Sep 2025 pipeline digest mentions Quarrendon but gives no ticket number. The Central digests have #4409 and #4412, but those are for Pree's dealer account, not Quarrendon.

I read these from the shared team-north and team-central digests, which are public. I didn't search across all channels or DMs. If Moss has other notes that aren't in those digests, I can't see them.
